args:
set -eu
printf 'schema=hcsn-c2-desktop-cgroup-witness-v1\n'
printf 'sampled_at_utc='
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
printf 'hostname='
hostname
printf 'kernel='
uname -srmo
awk '/^(MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree):/ {print "meminfo_" $1 "=" $2 " " $3}' /proc/meminfo
printf 'self_cgroup_begin\n'
cat /proc/self/cgroup
printf 'self_cgroup_end\n'
rel=$(awk -F: '$1=="0" {print $3}' /proc/self/cgroup)
case "$rel" in
  /*) ;;
  *) printf 'error=non_absolute_cgroup_path\n'; exit 41 ;;
esac
path="/sys/fs/cgroup$rel"
root="/sys/fs/cgroup"
depth=0
while :; do
  printf 'ancestor_begin depth=%s path=%s\n' "$depth" "$path"
  for name in memory.current memory.max memory.high memory.low memory.min memory.swap.current memory.swap.max memory.events memory.events.local cpu.max cpu.weight pids.current pids.max cgroup.controllers cgroup.events; do
    file="$path/$name"
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
      printf 'file=%s value_begin\n' "$name"
      cat "$file"
      printf 'file=%s value_end\n' "$name"
    else
      printf 'file=%s missing\n' "$name"
    fi
  done
  printf 'ancestor_end depth=%s path=%s\n' "$depth" "$path"
  [ "$path" = "$root" ] && break
  parent=$(dirname "$path")
  case "$parent" in
    "$root"|"$root"/*) ;;
    *) printf 'error=escaped_cgroup_root\n'; exit 42 ;;
  esac
  path="$parent"
  depth=$((depth + 1))
  [ "$depth" -le 32 ] || { printf 'error=ancestor_depth\n'; exit 43; }
done
printf 'complete=true\n'
refusal: do not retry with a new key
do not launch any model or training process
nonzero/timeout/missing output remains RED or UNKNOWN
point-in-time cgroup values do not constitute campaign allocation
